details:
This new update has severely upset me and a HUGE part of the community with the decision the staff team did, pretty much shattering it to an almost unrepairable state.
They've made the bed now they rest in it, in hoping with the recent announcement of saying that they hear our outcries of needing QoL changes along with saying and quoting these lines in the announcement "However, we hear you and see you saying that many of the modified client features that are being lost due to this are extremely important to you, or in some cases allow you to use VRChat at all, when in regards to modifications that added accessibility features that VRChat currently lacks. Our first priority for these changes is addressing several accessibility concerns in VRChat. We've got an internal list of improvements we can implement quickly and are fast-tracking it through our production and implementation process. We will be posting more information about those changes tomorrow.
This tomorrow better be worth it and better bring these changes fast. Pray on a miracle that the community you have chased away, will actually accept the game when it enters the upcoming future.
You may have made this ridiculous decision, but please keep to your promise of announcing these QoL changes to ur game and bring them out fast. As a user of EmmVRC and other QoL mods I also used, you may have shattered the credibility I had in you guys updating this game, but its not completely gone. This announcement better be worth the time and effort
title: VRChat Feedback on EAC
